title: Severe bleeding
summary: Firm, steady pressure is the most important thing you can do.
doSteps: Press hard on the wound with a clean cloth or your hand.
Keep pressing without stopping for at least 10 minutes.
If blood soaks through, add more cloth on top and keep pressing.
If the wound is on an arm or leg, raise it above the heart if you can.
Keep them lying down and warm.
dontSteps: Do not remove anything stuck in the wound. Press around it instead.
Do not keep lifting the cloth to check the bleeding.
Do not give food or drink.
